by: regulators-1 session (Opus), step 5.3; to be appended by the integrator at the merge
title: One page of an FMA list: warnings and alerts (/library/warnings-and-alerts/) or enforcement cases (/about-us/enforcement/cases/), HTML

landmarks: N results found (the list's own count)
up to 15 <li class="search-results-semantic__result-item"> blocks, each an <h3><a href="<list path><slug>/"> title and a search-results-semantic__date

signals_note: GET https://www.fma.govt.nz/<list path>[?start=15k] through the fetch gate, 5 s apart; landed verbatim by hash. A page with no results count is not this shape.
notes: Seen 21 October 2026: 726 warnings and alerts (back to 27 January 2010) and 99 enforcement cases, fifteen a page, newest first. The FMA re-dates a case when it updates it, so the listed date and title are the item's fingerprint. The warnings list also offers a CSV download by date range (downloadWarnings?DateFrom=…&DateTo=…), which carries no page address; it is not used.
applies_to: the FMA's two lists, from 21 October 2026
process: Recognise the page; a page not of this shape stops the pass (set aside).
One listed item per result: its slug, address and fingerprint (date and title as listed).
gates: Each list's distinct slugs equal its stated count within 2 (check.py).
on_fail: set the page aside; the pass resumes from it next run

by: regulators-1 session (Opus), step 5.3; to be appended by the integrator at the merge
title: One FMA warning or alert (www.fma.govt.nz/library/warnings-and-alerts/<slug>/, HTML)

landmarks: a body between 'registry-item-page__body-wrap-main"' and '<!--/Elemental Area Main Ends-->'

signals_note: GET the item's address from the list, through the fetch gate, 5 s apart; landed verbatim by hash. The site sits behind Cloudflare: a page titled 'Just a moment' or 'Attention Required' is a block, recognised by its own title, never by the challenge script, which ordinary pages carry too (lesson).
notes: Seen on ten warnings, 21 October 2026. Newer warnings head with 'Name – what it is' and end with labelled fields in <strong>: Entity Name, Address, Website, Email(s), Phone, Bank Name, Account Number … Older ones (2010) head with the entity's name alone and carry WARNING:, DATE:, OTHER INFORMATION: labels. Topic alerts ('Romance scam leads victims to fake banks') name no entity. An NZBN can be printed beside a name ('Baliex Limited (NZBN: 9429…)'). Emails are obfuscated by Cloudflare. The Address field can be a person's home: it is never read.
applies_to: the FMA's warnings and alerts, from 21 October 2026
process: Recognise the page; set it aside whole if it is not the shape.
One action row keyed by the slug: heading, date published, the description, each Act named by title, each 'section N of the <Act>' stated.
Parties: each value of a party field, split on ';'; else the heading before its dash; else the heading when it ends in a legal ending; else none (counted as naming nobody the reading can see).

A company number only where printed beside the name. Withheld where the FMA withholds, or where the page states a suppression and the party carries no organisation word; then heading, summary, address and slug are not kept, and the key is the slug's hash.
gates: Every listed item is an action row, a catch-log line or 'not captured' (check.py).
No withheld name, no address column, no street-shaped value on a view (check.py).

title: One FMA enforcement case (www.fma.govt.nz/about-us/enforcement/cases/<slug>/, HTML)

landmarks: a body between 'registry-item-page__body-wrap-main"' and '<!--/Elemental Area Main Ends-->'

usually an

Timeline

whose entries are headed

Month YYYY

or

D Month YYYY

signals_note: As the warning page; the same template.
notes: Seen on six cases, 21 October 2026. The heading is the party as the FMA names it ('BNZ', a person's name, 'Saanvi 2022 Limited (trading as Saaga Mortgages)', 'FMG Insurance Limited and Farmers' Mutual Group (FMG)'). Timeline entries are newest first, dated by day or by month; each has paragraphs and a list of related releases and documents.
applies_to: the FMA's enforcement cases, from 21 October 2026
process: Recognise the page; set it aside whole if it is not the shape.
One action row keyed by the slug, as the warning; the outcome is the latest timeline entry's paragraphs (without 'Related …' lines), its date as published, and the day only where one is given.
Parties: the heading, split on ' and ' only between two names that each carry a legal ending.
